scripts.data: uv run --with pyyaml tools/adapt_outputs.py && uv run --with pyyaml tools/build_video_data.py
scripts.score: node tools/render.mjs --stills 12 --out frames/probe --events audio/events.json && uv run --with numpy --with scipy --with pyloudnorm tools/soundtrack.py audio/events.json audio/score.wav
scripts.check: uv run --with numpy tools/check_outputs.py out/policyengine-30s-4k60.mp4 out/policyengine-30s-1080p60.mp4 out/policyengine-30s-vertical-1080x1920.mp4
scripts.test: bunx vitest run && uv run --with pytest --with hypothesis --with numpy --with scipy --with pyloudnorm --with pyyaml pytest -m 'not slow'
